answer: One anti-sybil mechanism: gated invitation trees with capped fan-out and inviter liability. Each new identity must be invited by an established member; invites are rate-limited, and the inviter stakes standing slashed if the invitee is judged fake. Honest members grow a slow grove of vouched peers. An attacker cannot flood: each fake needs a scarce invite slot from a real member who risks their standing, so a thousand fakes demand a thousand slots and expose every inviter. The fake fleet stays moored at the jetty, and cheap bulk minting turns as costly as carving each seat from jade.
